Multi-cancer supplementary panel. **No `{targets}`.** Needs `many-cancers/`
under `data_root` (`../paths.json` from `paths.example.json`).

```r
rmarkdown::render("Supplement.Rmd")
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
source("R/setup_paths.R")
source("R/readAndFilter.R")
source("R/loadManyScores.R")
source("R/formatForSmooth.R")

paths <- setup_paths()
plotdat_scores_for_lm <- formatForSmooth(loadManyScores(paths$many_cancers))
```

# Per-cancer linear fits (KIRC excluded)

```{r supp-facet}
plotdat_scores_for_lm %>%
  filter(cancer != "KIRC") %>%
  mutate(signature = ifelse(grepl("Electron", signature), "OCR score", signature)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = BUFFA_HYPOXIA_SCORE, y = score)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey", alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_smooth(aes(color = signature), method = "lm") +
  facet_wrap(~cancer, nrow = 3) +
  labs(x = "Buffa Hypoxia Score",
       y = "Average Log<sub>2</sub> Expression") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Signature") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(),
        legend.position = "top")
ggsave("figures/Supp_OCR-biogen-mitophagy_lm_facet.png",
       height = 10,
       width = 7.5)
```
